verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated first-party 'Coding agents' doc describing how to connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, Droid, and OpenCode directly via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or via Baseten Switch, plus a separate agent-setup guide for installing an MCP server/skill for workspace management. This directly matches the story of documented first-party agent integration guides. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming these integrations work smoothly in practice (community evidence present is generic, not agent-specific).
